title: Child unaware of continuous GPS data collection
description: The child may not be fully informed about the extent and purpose of GPS data collection by the app.

title: GPS data interception during transmission
description: Unencrypted GPS coordinates could be intercepted by attackers during transit.

title: Linking GPS data to track child's movements
description: Backend can correlate GPS data over time to track the child's location history.

title: Unauthorized use of GPS data by backend
description: Backend may use GPS data for purposes beyond the original intent, such as sharing with third parties.

title: Violation of data protection regulations
description: Backend's handling of child's GPS data may not comply with laws like GDPR or COPPA.

title: Unauthorized access to location data in transit
description: Location pings transmitted between P1 and P2 could be intercepted by attackers, leading to disclosure of user location information.
assumptions: Data is transmitted over network without end-to-end encryption or with weak encryption.

title: Location data used beyond geofencing purpose
description: Geofencing Engine may process or store location data for purposes other than zone entry/exit checks, such as user profiling or analytics.
assumptions: P2 lacks strict data usage policies or technical controls to limit data processing to the intended purpose.

title: Interception of zone data in transit
description: Zone definitions transmitted without encryption could be intercepted by attackers, leading to disclosure of sensitive location data.
uncertainty_note: Node ID D.2.1 assumed for data in transit interception; exact LINDDUN Pro node may vary.

title: Linking zone data to user identity
description: Geofencing engine correlates zone definitions with user profiles, enabling tracking of user movements and linking to their identity.
uncertainty_note: Node ID L.1.1 assumed for linkability; exact LINDDUN Pro node may vary.

title: Unauthorized use of zone data for secondary purposes
description: Zone data may be used for purposes beyond geofencing, such as targeted advertising, without user consent.
uncertainty_note: Node ID Dd.1.1 assumed for data misuse; exact LINDDUN Pro node may vary.

title: Data disclosed during transmission
description: Unencrypted communication between P2 and EE1 could allow interception of location notifications, exposing child's movement data to unauthorized parties.

title: Data used beyond intended purpose
description: Parent may use location data for purposes beyond geofencing alerts, such as sharing with third parties or tracking child's movements without consent.

title: Data subject unaware of processing
description: Child may not be informed that their location data is being monitored and shared with the parent, violating transparency principles.

title: Linkability of movement data
description: Parent can aggregate multiple notifications to create a detailed profile of the child's movements over time, increasing re-identification risk.

title: Excessive Data Collection
description: Backend transmits more data than necessary (e.g., full child profiles, geofence zones) without strict minimization, increasing privacy risk.
uncertainty_note: Assumes data minimization practices are not fully enforced.

title: Data Interception in Transit
description: Sensitive data (child profiles, geofence zones) transmitted without encryption could be intercepted by attackers.
uncertainty_note: Depends on whether TLS is enforced for this flow.

title: Insecure Data Storage
description: Data stored without adequate access controls or encryption at rest, risking unauthorized access.
uncertainty_note: Assumes no encryption at rest or weak access controls.

title: Linkability of Child Data
description: Combining child profiles with geofence data allows re-identification of children through data linkage.

title: Unauthorized Data Use
description: Stored data may be accessed or used beyond the intended purpose due to insufficient permission controls.
uncertainty_note: Assumes role-based access controls are not properly implemented.

title: Parent's identity linked to child's location data
description: The parent's request creates a link between their identity and the child's location information, enabling tracking of the parent's interactions with the child's data.
assumptions: Parent's identity is tied to the request metadata

title: Location data exposed during transmission
description: Unencrypted data flow allows interception of child's location by third parties during transit between Parent and Backend.
assumptions: Data flow lacks encryption or secure transport protocols

title: Excessive retention of location data
description: The backend retains location history beyond the required period, increasing exposure risk to unauthorized access or breaches.
assumptions: Backend stores data longer than necessary for service functionality

title: Inability to verify parent's access requests
description: Lack of audit logs for parent requests prevents accountability and verification of data access, enabling potential misuse.
assumptions: Backend does not maintain detailed access logs

title: Lack of transparency in data sharing
description: The child is not informed that their location data is being shared with the secondary guardian, leading to unawareness of data processing.
assumptions: Child's consent or notification mechanisms are not implemented.

title: Data interception during transmission
description: Location data transmitted without encryption could be intercepted by unauthorized parties.

title: Data used beyond original intent
description: Secondary guardian may use the child's location data for purposes other than intended, such as sharing with third parties.
assumptions: No technical or policy controls restrict guardian's data usage.

title: Re-identification via Aggregated Data
description: Aggregated analytics may allow linking data back to individual users if aggregation granularity is insufficient or combined with external datasets.
assumptions: Aggregation methods do not fully anonymize data; partner may have access to complementary datasets.
uncertainty_note: Node ID approximate; depends on actual aggregation techniques and partner data access.

title: Unauthorized Data Interception
description: Data in transit could be intercepted if transmission lacks encryption or secure protocols.
assumptions: Transmission security measures (e.g., TLS) are not explicitly confirmed.
uncertainty_note: Assumes unencrypted transmission; actual security implementation unknown.

title: Data Use Beyond Agreed Purpose
description: Partner may use analytics data for purposes beyond funding the app (e.g., targeted advertising, data brokerage).
assumptions: Partner's data usage policies are not transparent or enforceable.
uncertainty_note: Partner's contractual obligations and data practices unspecified.

title: Non-Compliance with Privacy Regulations
description: Partner may fail to comply with applicable data protection laws (e.g., GDPR, CCPA) when processing shared analytics.
assumptions: Partner operates in jurisdictions with strict privacy regulations.
uncertainty_note: Regulatory compliance status of partner unknown.

title: Lack of User Awareness
description: Users may not be adequately informed about data sharing with third-party analytics partners.
assumptions: Privacy policy disclosures are unclear or not prominently displayed.
uncertainty_note: Consent mechanisms and transparency practices not detailed.

title: Linkability of child's location data
description: Sharing location data allows linking to the child's identity and movement patterns, potentially enabling tracking or profiling.
assumptions: Child's location data is unique and can be correlated with other datasets.
uncertainty_note: Node ID based on standard LINDDUN Pro structure; exact node may vary.

title: Unauthorized access to location data in transit
description: Location data could be intercepted during transmission if not properly encrypted, exposing sensitive child location information.
assumptions: Data transmission may lack end-to-end encryption or use insecure channels.
uncertainty_note: Node ID based on standard LINDDUN Pro structure; exact node may vary.

title: Data misuse beyond intended purpose
description: Backend may use location data for purposes beyond check-in/SOS, such as behavioral profiling or third-party sharing.
assumptions: Backend processes data without strict purpose limitation controls.
uncertainty_note: Node ID based on standard LINDDUN Pro structure; exact node may vary.
